steps.title: Connect your Pin
steps.summary: Place your Pin on a USB interposer, then choose it in the browser.

steps.title: Network & time
steps.summary: Center turns on the Pin's Wi-Fi, joins your network over USB, and checks the Pin's clock.

steps.title: Install Luma
steps.summary: Center installs and checks the Luma release published on your server.

steps.title: Required services
steps.summary: Set up the assistant and speech. Every other service is optional.

steps.title: Connect to your Luma
steps.summary: Center points the Pin at your Luma server and pairs it with your account.

steps.title: Pin passcode
steps.summary: Finish the Pin's own setup when needed. A Pin that is already set up keeps its current passcode.

steps.title: Try it
steps.summary: Ask your Pin a question, then confirm that it heard, answered, and responded to your touch.
